— Meta Ads

Creative that earns attention. Campaigns with a purpose.

Facebook and Instagram help businesses reach people before they actively search. I plan Meta campaigns around a specific offer, relevant creative, and a clear route from interest to a useful inquiry or purchase.

Discuss meta ads

A connected approach to meta ads

Paid social asks for attention in a busy feed. That makes the message and creative as important as the account settings. A successful planning process asks why someone should care, what they need to understand, and what happens after they click. It also considers whether the business can respond to leads, fulfill orders, and explain its offer consistently across ads and landing pages.

When this work can help

  • Campaigns generate engagement but few useful business outcomes.
  • Creative is reused without a clear testing plan or fresh message.
  • Lead volume looks healthy while qualification and follow-up remain weak.

How I approach the work

I review the offer, existing campaign data, audience assumptions, creative assets, and post-click journey. We choose an objective that reflects the desired action, define what a qualified result means, and identify the assets needed before launch. Testing focuses on understandable differences in message, format, or destination so the findings can guide the next decision.

Core activities & deliverables

Audience and objective

Define customer needs, exclusions, campaign objectives, and budget guardrails. Consider broad delivery and first-party signals only where the data can be used appropriately.

Creative planning

Develop concepts and variations that explain the offer clearly. Organize approved assets, formats, and testing questions without making unsupported claims or implying platform partnerships.

Lead quality and optimization

Review placement, frequency, response quality, landing-page behavior, and conversion signals. Coordinate improvements with the people handling inquiries rather than optimizing solely for the cheapest form completion.

Who this is for

Meta advertising can suit businesses with a clear offer, visual or educational material, and the ability to test creative consistently. It may support a product launch, ongoing store growth, or service inquiries. Businesses with very limited creative capacity should account for the work needed to produce and maintain appropriate assets, rather than assuming that audience selection alone will solve performance problems.

What to consider before starting

Meta reporting is affected by consent, device restrictions, modelling, and attribution windows. A person may encounter several channels before acting. I do not promise a fixed acquisition cost or guaranteed sales. Retargeting depends on permitted audience signals and sufficient audience size; it is not a substitute for a strong offer.

How we assess progress

Useful reporting connects campaign costs with qualified inquiries, sales where trackable, and the practical findings from creative tests. Platform figures should be compared with the website and customer records where possible. Differences are investigated rather than hidden by choosing the most favorable dashboard.

Questions about meta ads

Do I need separate Facebook and Instagram campaigns?+

Not always. Placement choices should follow the objective, audience, and creative formats. Separate campaigns are useful when there is a specific operational or testing reason.

Can you help improve lead quality?+

Qualification questions, ad messaging, destination design, and follow-up can all influence quality. The right combination depends on your sales process and should be evaluated against real outcomes.
